# OpenProgram 1.0.0 Release Notes

OpenProgram 1.0.0 is the first release of the 1.x line. It gathers more than two thousand changes since 0.9.8: a desktop App with split views and a floating page preview, computer use that runs in the background, meetings, an always-on scheduler, a restructured runtime, and a separate stable and development install for people who build OpenProgram itself.

## ✨ New features

- **Split views and page preview.** Open chats, files and web pages side by side; a page the Agent is using floats in a preview window that docks, folds into its chip and follows the chat.
- **Computer use.** The Agent can drive desktop apps in the background, follows new windows and file dialogs, and shows a control overlay with its own cursor while it works.
- **Meetings.** Record call audio in two tracks, transcribe with timestamps and speaker separation, and summarize the call in a new conversation.
- **Scheduler and always-on Agents.** Schedule tasks on a calendar and keep Agents running between conversations.
- **Media in replies.** Images, video and audio the Agent sends show inside its reply.
- **Pinned chapters.** Pin a turn as a chapter; it stays marked on the message rail.
- **Launchpad.** Applications and abilities share one launcher with paged navigation.
- **Stable and development installs.** A development instance on its own port and data folder, with promotion to the stable App.

## 🐞 Bug fixes

- A one-shot CLI turn survives a worker restart, and the disconnect error names the close code.
- Long chat history keeps the reader's place after cache eviction and recovers from failed renewals.
- A tab moved between windows or panes keeps its history, scroll position and form values.
- The browser tool no longer hangs on a blank tab, and the page preview no longer flashes when clicked, dragged or covered by a menu.
- A restart's hidden resume turn no longer cuts the resumed branch off the conversation graph.
- Spawned workflow children keep their parent's channel and speech links.

## 🚀 Improvements

- The runtime is split into clear layers: the call core, conversations, jobs, permissions and the Agent registry, each importing only through its own interfaces.
- Model providers are grouped into catalog, settings, streaming and recording packages.
- The interface moves to one component and theme system: theme colours everywhere, consistent menus, buttons and shadows.
- Promotion keeps only the five newest pre-promotion backups.

Open the DMG and copy `OpenProgram.app` to `/Applications`. These macOS packages are Developer ID signed and Apple notarized.

### CLI / Server

Install this release on macOS or Linux; the installer selects the architecture and verifies the runtime:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://openprogram.io/install | OPENPROGRAM_VERSION=1.0.0 sh
```

## 🔄 Upgrade guide

- **Desktop:** download the matching DMG above and replace the existing application in `/Applications`.
- **CLI / Server:** run `openprogram upgrade`, or repeat the versioned installation command above.
- **Your data:** configuration, conversations, Programs, and saved progress under `~/.openprogram` are preserved.
- **After upgrading:** check `openprogram --version`. macOS Gatekeeper accepts the stapled notarization ticket; older unsigned packages may still require **Privacy & Security → Open Anyway**.

See the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/FuzzyKuji/OpenProgram/blob/v1.0.0/docs/install/upgrade.md) for details.
